title: Correctness of randomized selection
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a linearly ordered type, let $l$ be a finite list in $\alpha$, and let $k$ satisfy $1\le k\le |l|$. Every outcome $(a,c)$ in the support of the randomized selection procedure on input $(k,l)$ has $a= y$ for some entry $y$ of $l$ such that the number of entries strictly less than $y$ is less than $k$, and the number of entries less than or equal to $y$ is at least $k$.
hypotheses_covered: The outcome lies in the support of the procedure
